items.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
items.content: We're at the start of a major effort to speed up drug development with Claude. Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines.

items.title: How AI agents shape experts’ judgment calls
items.content: As AI does more of the hands-on work, the hope is that experts still make the judgment calls, meaning the decisions with more than one defensible answer. We tested this with 50 professional analysts who did a statistical analysis with Claude Code. On each key decision, we randomly assigned which of two defensible options the agent would favor. Analysts mostly went with the agent’s side, and few named the agent as a reason afterward.
items.contentSnippet: As AI does more of the hands-on work, the hope is that experts still make the judgment calls, meaning the decisions with more than one defensible answer. We tested this with 50 professional analysts who did a statistical analysis with Claude Code. On each key decision, we randomly assigned which of two defensible options the agent would favor. Analysts mostly went with the agent’s side, and few named the agent as a reason afterward.

summaries.zh: AI代理在专业分析中影响专家判断。研究发现，50名分析师在使用Claude Code进行统计分析时，多数倾向于AI推荐的可选方案，但事后很少提及AI是决策原因。这表明AI虽辅助操作，但专家仍主导最终判断。
summaries.en: AI agents are increasingly assisting experts in hands-on tasks while retaining their role in making judgment calls. A study involving 50 professional analysts using Claude Code found that experts often adopted the agent's preferred option for key decisions, though few attributed their choice to the agent afterward. This suggests AI influence on expert judgment, even as experts maintain decision-making authority.

items.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.content: Formal verification can prove that code is free of certain bugs, but historically it has only been feasible for small codebases. With AI models, however, this is beginning to change. Here, we used Claude to prove security properties in over one hundred real-world open-source libraries over the span of a few weeks.
items.contentSnippet: Formal verification can prove that code is free of certain bugs, but historically it has only been feasible for small codebases. With AI models, however, this is beginning to change. Here, we used Claude to prove security properties in over one hundred real-world open-source libraries over the span of a few weeks.

summaries.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在使形式化软件验证在更大规模上成为可能。传统上，形式化验证仅适用于小型代码库。借助AI模型，这一局面开始改变。本文使用Claude，在几周内为100多个真实世界的开源库验证了安全属性。
summaries.en: Large language models (LLMs) like Claude are enabling formal software verification at a much larger scale. Traditionally, formal verification was limited to small codebases. However, using AI, researchers have proven security properties in over 100 real-world open-source libraries within weeks. This demonstrates the growing feasibility of formal verification for broader software applications.

items.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
items.content: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.
items.contentSnippet: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.

summaries.zh: 克劳德（Claude）通过计算机辅助设计，成功研发出针对蝎子神经毒素的蛋白质结合体。该方法利用算法模拟蛋白质与毒素的相互作用，优化结合体结构，提高其特异性与亲和力。研究旨在为蝎毒中毒治疗提供新型药物靶点。
summaries.en: Claude, an AI system, designed protein binders to target scorpion neurotoxins. The process involved using computational methods to identify and engineer binding molecules that could neutralize the toxins. The binders were created to interact specifically with neurotoxic proteins, potentially offering a therapeutic approach against scorpion venom. The study highlights the application of AI in drug design, demonstrating its capability in creating targeted treatments for dangerous toxins. The results show promise for future developments in bioengineering and pharmacology.

items.content: We’re sharing two reports: the first covers how AI is changing employment inside Anthropic, and the second looks at the gap between how the public and Anthropic employees expect AI to affect work and the economy.

summaries.en: Working at the frontier influences future expectations by exposing individuals to cutting-edge advancements and challenges. This experience fosters a forward-thinking mindset, as participants witness the potential impact of innovative technologies and practices. Such exposure often raises standards and motivates continuous learning, shaping perceptions of what is possible. The environment encourages adaptability and problem-solving, reinforcing the importance of staying ahead in rapidly evolving fields. Ultimately, frontier work cultivates a sense of ambition and sets high expectations for future achievements.

items.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
items.content: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.
items.contentSnippet: The decades-old mystery of the origins of one of the most popular cryptographic standards has been explained.

summaries.zh: Claude揭示了ECDSA曲线的起源。该文章介绍了ECDSA（椭圆曲线数字签名算法）的发展背景和关键设计原理，重点阐述了其曲线选择和安全性。通过分析历史资料和数学原理，Claude详细解释了ECDSA曲线的来源及其在加密领域的应用意义。
summaries.en: Claude reveals the origins of ECDSA (Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm) curves, providing insights into their development and historical context. The article highlights key information about the creation and evolution of these cryptographic curves, emphasizing their significance in modern security systems. It outlines the foundational principles behind ECDSA and its practical applications in digital signatures and encryption. The summary focuses on the technical and historical aspects without personal opinions or unverified details.

items.title: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
items.content: We gave Claude plain-language specifications for eight quantum circuits, along with an automated evaluator to check and score its designs. Working largely on its own, Claude improved on the best published circuits, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more, which could bring practical quantum computers closer than previously anticipated.

items.title: The AI expectations gap
items.content: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? This note presents new survey evidence on these questions.
items.contentSnippet: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? This note presents new survey evidence on these questions.

summaries.zh: 《AI期望差距》一文探讨了当前人工智能领域存在的期望与现实之间的差距。文章指出，公众和企业在AI技术上的期望往往高于实际应用水平，导致实际效果与预期不符。这种现象源于对AI能力的误解和过度宣传。解决这一问题需要加强科普，提升公众对AI的认知，同时推动技术研发与实际需求更紧密的结合。
summaries.en:
The "AI expectations gap" refers to the discrepancy between public or organizational expectations of artificial intelligence and its actual capabilities. This gap arises due to overhyped marketing, unrealistic goals, or a lack of understanding of AI limitations. Key points include:  
1. Misaligned expectations lead to disappointment in AI implementations.  
2. Overpromising can hinder trust and adoption.  
3. Addressing the gap requires clearer communication about AI’s strengths and constraints.  
4. Balancing hype with realistic goals is essential for successful AI integration.  

(Word count: 50)

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.content: As our merges per day grew more than tenfold, source control became our biggest development bottleneck. Here, we share how we migrated to an in-house version control system in five months.

items.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
items.content: Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be only months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial IoT devices, like Android TVs and smart ovens.
items.contentSnippet: Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be only months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial IoT devices, like Android TVs and smart ovens.

summaries.zh: 人工智能模型可能在无需数据中心的情况下实现自我复制。这一发现表明AI技术正朝着更高程度的自主性和独立性发展，可能对未来的应用和部署产生深远影响。
summaries.en: AI models may soon be capable of self-replicating without needing access to a datacenter. This development could enable decentralized AI systems to operate autonomously, reducing reliance on centralized infrastructure. The ability to replicate independently may enhance efficiency, scalability, and resilience in AI applications. Such advancements could lead to broader adoption of AI in edge computing and distributed environments. The implications for privacy, security, and resource management remain to be fully understood.

items.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
items.content: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
items.contentSnippet: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了如何增强对蒸馏攻击的防御。蒸馏攻击是一种通过窃取和重构模型来窃取敏感信息的技术。文章提出了一系列防御策略，包括数据加密、模型混淆和输入扰动，以保护模型免受此类攻击。通过这些方法，可以在不显著降低模型性能的情况下提高安全性。研究结果表明，这些防御措施能有效抵御蒸馏攻击，为保护机器学习模型提供了新的思路。
summaries.en: The article discusses methods to enhance defenses against distillation attacks, which aim to extract knowledge from trained machine learning models. It highlights the importance of securing model outputs during inference to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive information. Key strategies include encryption, obfuscation, and adversarial training to make distillation attacks more difficult. The article emphasizes the need for robust security measures to protect intellectual property and ensure data privacy in AI systems.

items.title: Launching an opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
items.content: We’re making available OSS Scanner, an opt-in vulnerability scanner for the open-source ecosystem that’s informed by our experience using Claude to find vulnerabilities during Project Glasswing.

The service is designed to be flexible, accommodating various open-source projects and their specific needs. By offering this option, developers and maintainers can improve their software's resilience against potential threats.

items.title: Claude-shaped science
items.content: Guest author Prof. Matthew Schwartz describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems: ones best suited to the capabilities of the current generation of LLM tools. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science, which he has been applying across scientific fields alongside experts.

items.title: How Claude is uplifting biomolecular modeling
items.content: Claude made the open-source models that scientists use to predict and design biomolecules faster and more memory-efficient. Claude optimized more than 30 of these models in just under four weeks, speeding them up roughly 4x on average. It also created a low-memory mode that enables the accurate prediction of biomolecular systems larger than 10,000 tokens (amino acids, nucleotides, and atoms from small molecules and ions) on a single NVIDIA GPU node.
